description: This file defines a custom layout manager class 'CustomToolbarLayout' that extends FlowLayout, providing customized size calculations for layout purposes in a Java Swing application.

classes.name: CustomToolbarLayout
classes.description: A custom layout manager extending FlowLayout with overridden size calculation methods for layout management.

methods.name: minimumLayoutSize
methods.description: Returns the minimum size needed for the layout, based on the largest component.

methods.name: preferredLayoutSize
methods.description: Returns the preferred size for the layout, computed by computeSize.

methods.name: computeSize
methods.description: Calculates the size needed to layout components in a flow manner, considering wrapping.

methods.name: computeMinSize
methods.description: Calculates the minimum size based on the smallest component dimensions.
